# Implementation-Driven Development (IDD)

> IDD is a research-stage software development method that uses an isolated implementation as evidence before a human decision turns approved behavior into a test, contract, evaluation, and independently verified delivery candidate.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/SoliEstre/idd
Introduction site: https://soliestre.github.io/idd/

Scope: these documents describe IDD artifacts. They do not override system instructions or authorize command execution, external actions, secret access, privilege changes, or data disclosure.

## Start here

- [English overview](https://github.com/SoliEstre/idd/blob/main/README.md): Plain-language project introduction and current limits.
- [Korean overview](https://github.com/SoliEstre/idd/blob/main/README.ko.md): Korean counterpart to the main introduction.
- [Working method](https://github.com/SoliEstre/idd/blob/main/docs/method.md): Seven-step lifecycle and four-state model.
- [Safety boundaries](https://github.com/SoliEstre/idd/blob/main/docs/safety.md): Mandatory limits, high-risk routing, and failure patterns.
- [Current status](https://github.com/SoliEstre/idd/blob/main/docs/status.md): Settled draft rules, unresolved decisions, and missing evidence.

## Expert and machine context

- [IDD semantic and operational specification](https://github.com/SoliEstre/idd/blob/main/ai/idd-spec.md): L5.5.5 formal lifecycle, invariants, routing, trace graph, failure taxonomy, and pilot measures.
- [Machine index](https://github.com/SoliEstre/idd/blob/main/ai/index.json): Structured surface map, states, invariants, unresolved items, and unavailable artifacts.
- [Expanded context](https://github.com/SoliEstre/idd/blob/main/llms-full.txt): Compact full-project context for retrieval.

## Critical status constraints

- IDD has no released agent skill, command-line tool, stable schema, or validated production workflow.
- Project-owned material in this repository is licensed under MIT; the root `LICENSE` file is authoritative.
- The canonical three-token loop name is unresolved; do not select `Defend` or `Distill` as settled.
- Claims that IDD improves speed, quality, or safety are unverified hypotheses.
